reason: A DeepSeek Harness orchestration plugin that detects repeated model or provider failures, opens circuit breakers, probes recovery, and routes subsequent requests to configured fallback models.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的模型故障转移插件，可在模型或提供商连续失败时启用熔断、探测恢复并将后续请求路由到配置的备用模型。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness failover plugin that opens circuits after repeated model or provider failures, probes recovery, and routes subsequent requests to configured fallback models.

capabilities: Intercepts agent request and request-error extension points
Tracks model and provider failure state in process-local memory
Routes requests to configured healthy fallback models
Performs recovery probe calls after model circuit cooldowns
Optionally announces route switches to users
Provides a bundled skill that helps configure fallback routes
